thread:
jamal_support: FYI escalating Springboard trial — embed ingestion failing, customers seeing 502 on chunked uploads, high churn signal from support dashboard. Need CS handoff asap.

maria_cs: Thanks @jamal_support — what tier/renewal date? Any P0 symptoms? :thinking:

jamal_support: tier: Team trial, renewal in 11 days. Symptoms: upload errors block training, customer can't complete onboarding steps 2-4. See error snippet below:
```
POST /api/v1/ingest 502 Bad Gateway
{"error":"chunked write failed: kvcache overflow"}
```

olivia_se: @jamal_support can you attach the full logs and the request id? quick workaround: reduce batch_size to 128 and disable concurrent uploads. That should let them finish onboarding while we investigate.

jamal_support: request_id=rcq-2026-03-21-77b; log tail pasted to thread — trying workaround now, will update.

devon_am: Heads-up: this account is up for renewal in 11 days. If they can't ingest their corpus by EOT trial they're likely to churn. Prioritize comms and offer a 2-week extension if needed.

maria_cs: Agreed. I'll schedule a 1:1 onboarding session for Wed and prepare extension offer. @arjun_cs can you draft an email template with remediation steps + extension language?

arjun_cs: On it. Drafting now, will post here for review. Suggested subject: "Quick fix + 2-week trial extension for Springboard"

kate_eng: tagging eng-runtime — can we check for KV cache pressure / kernel OOMs on the node they hit? @eng-runtime

ops_bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-314 — Assigned to eng-runtime oncall.

olivia_se: Quick Q — what's the model + quantization/seq len? memory profile matters for workaround.

jamal_support: using redwood/open-llama-7b, quant=8bit, seq_len~1024.

kate_eng: thanks — will spin up a diagnostic instance against the customer's tenant and check kernel logs. ETA ~2h.

maria_cs: Plan of record: 1) SE applies reduced batch/concurrency workaround so customer can finish onboarding, 2) CS offers 2-week extension proactively, 3) Eng diagnostics + root cause + remediation, 4) follow-up postmortem + churn prevention note to account owner.

jamal_support: Workaround confirmed partial success — uploads completing with batch_size=128 and concurrency=1, ingestion rate slower but progressing. Will monitor.

maria_cs: Great. I'll wait for final confirm before emailing. If still unstable by EOD we'll send the extension note and book a follow-up session. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
